user_query: I'm organizing a conference on crypto and I need to stay updated on the latest news. Can you provide me with the latest news on crypto from various sources? Additionally, I want to gather information about climate change news worldwide. Thank you!

TaskList.description: Fetch the latest cryptocurrency news from multiple sources.
Fetch the latest news about climate change from various reliable news outlets.
Compile and summarize the results of the cryptocurrency news and climate change news.
